text.tspan: Economic decline in the second quarter of 2020
The percentage decline of GDP relative to the same quarter in 2019. It is adjusted for inflation.

tspan.tspan: Eurostat, OECD and individual national statistics agencies
Data for China is not shown given the earlier timing of its economic downturn. The country saw positive growth of 3.2% in Q2 preceded

text.tspan: by a fall of 6.8% in Q1
